description: The chosen numeral-substitution graph for \(A\) holds in \(\mathbb N_A\) at \((\vec n,a)\) exactly when \(a=\ulcorner A(\overline{\vec n})\urcorner\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.substitutionGraph_standard {r : ℕ}
  (A : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin r)) (x : Fin r → ℕ) (a : ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.substitutionGraph A).Realize
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x a) ↔
    a =
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.numeralInstance A x)
